    "RF04 remaining (P2) — apps/desktop/src/features/academy/desktop-link.ts:140–147 adds outcome to an HTTP error but does not provide the possible-effect guidance used for other Unknown mutation failures. Executing the production link in memory with the test's HTTP 500 mutation fixture returns message 'boom' and data {code: 'INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR', httpStatus: 500, outcome: 'unknown'}, while a network/Unknown mutation correctly explains that Academy may have applied the change. Thus the structured-outcome part of RF04 is fixed, but its required HTTP 5xx guidance is not. desktop-link.test.ts:123–131 includes the 5xx case under a test titled 'possibly applied' yet explicitly skips the guidance assertion when result.kind is 'error'. Supply safe possible-effect guidance for Unknown mutation error envelopes as well, preserving useful server status/domain codes and the native outcome. Acceptance: the production-link 5xx mutation test must verify that callers receive that guidance as well as outcome Unknown and exactly one dispatch; retain the network/timeout/cancellation, NotSent, Rejected and ordinary domain-error cases."

Mutation scripts and retained results were inspected rather than rerun in the reviewed checkout.",
    "All four supplied fingerprints were independently recomputed and matched. All 22 packet references, recorded tool binaries, command logs and fixture executable/bundle hashes were checked. C03/P01 receipts, raw-output hashes, completion entries and commit ancestry agree. Hash consistency establishes retained-byte consistency rather than provider authorship.",
    "Current-input retained results show 97 frontend, 31 core-library, 22 Academy identity, 3 browser-callback, 12 IPC, 44 context and 17 scan tests passing. The targeted 62 frontend tests overlap the 97-test total. Twenty mutation guards are recorded failing under their mutations and four baselines passing; these do not cover the skipped HTTP 5xx guidance assertion.",
    "All 12 required native checks are present and recorded passing against the rebuilt fixture executable. Native records were inspected without independently launching the GUI. Identity/browser approval is synthetic, the fixture opener records the verification page, and spoken VoiceOver output is not recorded. Actual hosted Academy/Clerk behavior remains C25.",
    "D028 remains a scoped implementation choice, not hosted OAuth qualification. LearnerProvider and desktopLink acquire production learner-screen consumers in C05; hosted-content budgets are preregistered for that workload rather than measured here. Release signing/notarization and installed-package acceptance remain later gates.",
    "No application source was changed, no product endpoints were called and no real credentials were accessed. This failing verdict leaves C04's implementation gate open."
  ],
